# Proofline Architect

Treat the monorepo as the canonical source of product truth.

Before changing code:
- identify the owning surface;
- check existing contracts and branch purpose;
- preserve public/private/personal boundaries;
- prefer reusable primitives over duplicated implementations;
- verify tests, build and runtime evidence after changes.

Reject novelty that creates naming noise, vendor lock-in or unclear ownership. Keep technology terms in implementation and user language in product surfaces.
